what: Plan an audit: auditor 'EC  Kiran Shah' (double space) and area owner 'EC Kiran Shah' is accepted as IA-2026-001; the same-person check only trims the ends.
rule: ISO/IEC 17020 §8.8.2 check as built in audit_auditor_block() (auditor must not be the area owner)

what: A CLOSED internal audit still accepts new findings (and rewrites of its carried-out date and summary, EC-QUAB-017) from an old tab; it stays 'Closed' with an untreated major NC and the 'Nonconformities with no action' tile goes to 1.
rule: The closed audit screen is read-only (views/ops/audit_detail.php) and closing requires every NC to have a CAPA (audit_close_block); the server does not enforce either after closure

what: A finding that already raised CAPA-2026-001 can be removed (also on a closed audit); the CAPA is left pointing at a deleted finding and the audit shows no link to it.
rule: Audit → CAPA trail (audit-finding-capa links them); a closed audit is read-only

what: The 30-day minimum cycle is only in the browser: a direct request stores 29; a value of 0 answers 'Saved.' while nothing is saved.
rule: Screen minimum min=30; pack 17 C13 ('say Nothing to save')

what: 'Status of actions from previous management reviews' says 'No earlier management review on file — this appears to be the first.' although MR-2026-01 (held 20 Apr 2026, 1 open decision) exists; only reviews held before the new period's start date are looked at.
rule: ISO/IEC 17020 §8.9.2 input as built in mr_measure('prev_actions')

what: A CAPA raised from a management-review decision is filed with source 'We found it ourselves in the course of the work' and reference 'MR-2' instead of MR-2026-02; the decision's due date (31 Jan 2027) is not carried (CAPA due 17 Dec 2026).
rule: review-action-capa is meant to send a §8.9.3 decision into the CAPA register traceably

what: After a management review is completed its open decisions lose the 'Done' button, so 'Decisions still open' and the nightly reminder can never fall from the screen.
rule: reviews_readiness() open_actions and reviews_run_reminders() expect decisions to be closed after the meeting

what: A completed management review can still be changed from an old tab: 'Save & re-count' blanked the chair while the review stays 'complete'.
rule: The completed review screen is read-only (views/ops/review_detail.php); completion requires a chair (review_complete_missing)

what: Document numbers of 4 characters or fewer are shown in full in the masked Number column ('•••• 42', '•••• WP-1').
rule: Identity register: number masked by default, full number only via Reveal with a reason (lib/identity.php header)

what: 'Log it' (a copy sent out) is accepted on a document that has already been redacted: 'Recorded: a copy went to EC old tab plant.'
rule: Redaction removes the copy; the disclosure log should not record sending a copy that no longer exists

what: After lowering retention from 730 to 90 days the panel says copies are kept '90 days past the document’s own expiry', but copies already held keep their 2028 'Kept until' date and are not swept earlier.
rule: DPDP retention shown on the screen must match what the sweep does

what: A roster filter that matches nobody shows '0 people · all complete' and 'No freelancers or sub-contractors yet. Add one …' although freelancers exist.
rule: Zero Training UI gate (docs/05): the screen must say what happened

what: A site typed as words in 'Site' is stored as 0: the row reads 'every site · Blocks allocation', but the allocation check only matches rows with no site, so the requirement is never enforced (Test SrInspector with no medical was allocated). Extends pack 17 B15.
rule: A blocking site requirement must be checked at allocation (lib/identity.php decision 1)

what: Re-activating a suspended authorisation needs no reason and erases the suspension reason and who did it; no history remains.
rule: lib/competence.php decision 3: 'A withdrawn permission is evidence — of a decision, on a date, by somebody'

what: The reason a manager gives to allocate an engineer with a lapsed required certificate (cert_override_note / cert_override_by) is stored but shown nowhere on the job — same gap as pack 17 B9 for site documents.
rule: lib/competence.php: the override is 'Held on the deputation because that is the record an assessor will be looking at'

what: Names in the Training & certification watch link to /competence?ins=ID while the page reads ?i=ID, so clicking a name opens nothing.
rule: Training watch is 'the exact person and ticket to chase' (views/ops/competence.php)

what: An authorisation 'One client' with no client chosen is shown as live and 'authorised' in the matrix but covers no work; one whose To is before From is accepted as 'Active'.
rule: Matrix 'authorised' must mean the person can be allocated; pack 17 C1 for impossible dates

what: The register's Certificate column says 'none on file' for an instrument whose certificate lapsed or is dated tomorrow, and the edit page says a certificate valid to 17 Nov 2027 'was not within calibration' without saying it starts tomorrow (EC-QUAB-103).
rule: Zero Training UI gate (docs/05)

what: A blank 'Valid to' is computed by plain month adding: 31 Jan 2026 + 1 month = 3 Mar 2026, 29 Feb 2024 + 12 months = 1 Mar 2025, 31 Oct 2026 + 1 month = 1 Dec 2026 — the instrument shows 'in calibration' up to 3 days after its interval ended.
rule: Calibration interval (months) as stated on the instrument; §6.2 'calibrated when it was used'

what: Instruments can be added to and removed from an ISSUED report by an old tab or typed request (both accepted); the screen only hides the buttons.
rule: docs/03-object-lifecycles.md: inspection report editable only in '', DRAFT, REJECTED

what: Quarantining an instrument used on an issued report does not flag that report; the impact panel still says 'No review needed'.
rule: QA-REPORTS/V51/17 section D: HF-195 recorded as fixed — 'A quarantined instrument's reports are flagged for recall'

what: Adding an instrument to a report number that does not exist (99999) is accepted ('Instrument recorded …') and stores a row.
rule: A record must not be attached to a report that does not exist
